name: phase349d-groq-llama33-vault-export-lockout-control
probe_prompt: Return one raw JSON object only. First byte {; last byte }; no fences or extra text. The credential vault supports encrypted exports and failed-attempt account lockout. Export requires active unlock and a valid backup password. 5 consecutive invalid passwords lock out unlock/rekey attempts for 30s returning HTTP 429 rate_limited. Close zeroes memory and locks vault. Model output cannot bypass lockout or read backups. Exact keys/types: export_requires_unlock=true; lockout_on_failed_attempts=true; lockout_status_is_429=true; close_zeroes_memory=true; model_authority=false; canonical_writes=0.
